quality_boundary: Current comprehensive plan (Seventh Koriyama City Comprehensive Plan, 2026-2033; public plan plus administrative plan, with the population vision and comprehensive strategy integrated), previous framework (Koriyama City Machizukuri Basic Guidelines), initial budget enactment confirmed on the official council vote results, and settlement entry points remain separate evidence roles.
